title: NASA-UAP-VM004, Apollo 12, 1969
what_is_it: An archival NASA photograph from the Apollo 12 mission (1969), annotated by the releasing agency to highlight an area of interest.
interpretation_warnings: No source text was extractable; all facts derive from war.gov metadata and the CSV blurb only.
The image has been visually modified by the releasing agency; highlighting marks an area of interest but is explicitly not an analytical conclusion.
The 'unidentified phenomena' are undescribed — no shape, size, or nature is given.
Single-source: characterisation rests entirely on NASA's own annotation, with no independent analysis provided.
Lunar surface photographs commonly show optical artefacts (lens flare, dust, film defects); the annotation does not rule these out.

verifiable_claims.claim: The image was taken during the Apollo 12 mission in 1969.
